workflowHeaders..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

# Strict consumer verifies committed dependency bindings and complete lock integrity.
# Build and test outcomes remain independent qualification gates.

# Single source of truth for the test gates. `release.yml` calls this
# workflow (workflow_call) instead of copy-pasting the jobs, so the gates
# cannot drift between the push/PR path and the release path.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_call:
workflowHeaders..github/workflows/development.yml:
name: Development Core integration

# This edited development graph is supplementary evidence. Ordinary versioned
# CI and release preflight remain unchanged and separately required.
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/perf-refinement-20260918]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
workflowHeaders..github/workflows/docs.yml:
name: Docs

# Build the DocC catalog (Sources/Lattice/Lattice.docc) and deploy it to
# GitHub Pages at https://jsflax.github.io/lattice/documentation/lattice/.
# Runs on main pushes that can change the rendered docs (the catalog, doc
# comments in Lattice sources, the manifest) and on demand.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "Sources/Lattice/**"
      - "Package.swift"
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One Pages deployment at a time; a newer push supersedes an in-flight one.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true
workflowHeaders..github/workflows/release.yml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ['[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+']

permissions:
  contents: write

intent: Publish exact previously source-reviewed private opt-in SDK source for authenticated future hosted fetch; no workflow dispatch/release/merge
